{{Quote|Grathan's trouble, see. Big trouble. Mad scientist type. Likes weapons. Cyborgs. Droids. Ergonomic chairs.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Bryn (Human)|Bryn]]|<ref name="TOR:SW">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Strange Weapons|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref>}}
'''Lord Grathan's forces''' were a military force that was based on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], commanded by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Grathan]] when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] declared himself as the thirteenth [[Dark Council]] member. His claim however wasn't officially recognized and the Council authorized an all-out warfare against him and all his allies.

The army was made up of [[Sith apprentice/Legends|sith apprentices]], loyal [[Imperial soldier]]s and [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] supersoldiers that Grathan developed in his secret weapons labs. It also contained his cadre of elite [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]. Some volunteers, others kidnapped and forced into service, they started manufacturing a seemingly endless number of [[Battle droid/Legends|war droids]]. The army was pushed out of [[Kaas City]] and found their headquarters on [[Lord Grathan's estate]] where [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] slew several when [[Mission to Lord Grathan's estate|stealing]] a weapon from Grathan.

Grathan's forces would suffer numerous causalities over a period of weeks, during the tenure of a [[Empire's Wrath|Sith Warrior]] serving as [[Darth Baras]]'s enforcer during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] was sent to Grathan in order to wound of his secret son [[Beelzlit Grathan]]. The Warrior carved through the defenses destroying many war droids and killing many of Grathan's troops to reach the inner circle and be a breath away from the Sith Lord whom he was ordered not to kill. In the ensuing fight, Grathan's wife and son were killed which in turn forced Grathan to send his most deadly assassin to kill the Warrior for revenge. Around the same time a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], hired by Admiral [[Fraabaal]], attacked the base, killing several of Grathan's acolytes and defeating his apprentice [[Vereta Fraabaal]].

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Grathan's forces appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. This organization represents the entire Grathan forces in Dromund Kaas. They appear most notably in the Sith Inquisitor's main quest "Dismantling the Machine" and are mentioned in the game's codex under the name of "Grathan Forces."
